rules.sentence: Most injuries can be diagnosed clinically without requiring advanced imaging or arthroscopy and may receive non-operative treatment.
In some cases, advanced imaging and/or surgical interventions may be necessary.
Wrist sprains occur when a ligament is pathologically stretched, twisted, lacerated, or torn.
In severe cases, there can be a large tear in multiple wrist ligament(s), which can cause instability of the wrist and may require surgical interventions.
